_comment: Vercel Firewall custom rules for the CRM (owner 2026-11-13). Applied with scripts/firewall-apply.mjs (vercel firewall CLI). 'enforce' is each rule's real action; the script's 'log' mode turns every rule into Log first. Only browser pages are challenged: /api/*, /native-*-updates, /_next, favicon, logos and every other path never match.

rules.name: CRM pages challenge
rules.description: Browser challenge on the client sign-in pages: /login, /register and every /portal page (forgot/reset password included). API, feeds and static files never match.

rules.name: Login API per-IP limit
rules.description: POST /api/portal/login: 30 per minute per IP, then 429 (the app's own limits stay behind it).

rules.name: Register API per-IP limit
rules.description: POST /api/portal/register: 10 per minute per IP, then 429 (the app's own limits stay behind it).
